meta.title: The single stage screen opens on RFP with everything locked until a template is chosen

steps.note: Open the Events list from which the creation flow begins.
Verify the Events list rendered with its creation control and no error.
Open the Create Event menu and verify the Single Stage path is offered.
Choose the Single Stage creation flow.
Verify the new Single Stage screen has RFP selected by default.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the title field is present on the creation screen.
Verify Terms & Conditions is greyed out before template selection.
Verify the schedule control is greyed out before template selection.
Verify publishing is unavailable before template selection.

args.control: Search vendors you want to add

steps.note: Verify vendor search is disabled before template selection.
Verify Single Stage does not provide a Save as draft button.
